purpose: Additional reviewed installable/reference motion and visual-production skills discovered 2026-09-10. Local AWFUL contracts override all entries.

skills.name: video-shotcraft
skills.notes: Large shot-recipe library and production workflow using Remotion, screenshots, 2.5D camera moves, beat-synced cuts and sound design.

skills.name: greybox-harness
skills.notes: Blender greybox/previs layer for locking scene geography, camera and cut timing before expensive AI-video generation.

skills.name: cinematic-director
skills.notes: Director/previs workflow for beats, blocking, coverage, shot rationale, keyframes, motion prompts and continuity. Use observable camera/action instructions, not adjective soup.

skills.name: svg-character-animator
skills.notes: Production SVG character state-machine approach with morph/transform selection and per-state idle motion. Useful for vector mascots and UI pets.

skills.name: hyperframes-animation
skills.notes: Deterministic motion knowledge and adapters for HyperFrames. Pair with local identity/motion rules rather than letting runtime recipes define art direction.

skills.name: remotion-clone-video
skills.notes: Frame-extract -> storyboard -> code -> render-stills -> compare loop for reconstructing owned/reference motion as editable Remotion code.

skills.name: video-storyboard-gen
skills.notes: Executable storyboard/shot planning with continuity and AI-video prompt output. Useful as a specialist reference; AWFUL directing rules remain authoritative.

skills.name: film-storyboard-skill
skills.notes: Script-to-storyboard and sequence-board workflow with generation-oriented panel prompts.

skills.name: video-to-skill
skills.notes: Turns tutorials/playlists/courses into evidence-grounded operational skills. Useful for capturing demonstrated visual-production workflows instead of transcript-only summaries.

skills.name: manim-video
skills.notes: Programmatic explanatory animation pipeline for diagrams, algorithms, data stories and educational visuals.

skills.name: animation-principles
skills.notes: Broad skill collection applying the classical 12 animation principles across media and task types. AWFUL's local Disney contract remains the normalized source of truth.

skills.name: 3d-animation-short-generator
skills.notes: Strong end-to-end animated-short reference: brief -> story -> character/environment cards -> shots -> storyboard -> generation -> assembly -> BGM -> final review.

skills.name: video
skills.notes: Broad video-production routing across AI and programmatic tools. Use for commercial-video context, not as a replacement for AWFUL motion/continuity rules.

skills.name: review-animations
skills.notes: High-craft review layer for interface/web animation. Narrower than AWFUL visual QA and useful specifically for coded UI motion.
